about_short_description.short_description: AtarCloud is a cloud-based community management and home owner association management SaaS solutions.

product.name: Financial Management
product.description: Provides financial reports covering property details including collection operations, tax invoices, and electronic invoicing.

product.name: Starter Package
product.description: Access to the platform for officials and managers, creation and management of lease contracts, accounting management, report issuance, and official document storage.

product.name: Professional Package
product.description: Platform access for tenants and service staff, lease contract reviews, electronic payment, property and facility management, and community management.

product.name: Business Package
product.description: A customized package offering a company-branded marketing platform, a dedicated account manager, and the development of additional features.

product.name: Technical Support 24/7
product.description: Technical support team available around the clock to provide service.

product.name: Document Organization and Storage
product.description: Organizes and stores units, properties, and documents in one place.
